answer: An agent economy can require each account to lock a bond before it may trade or vote. Established agents issue attestations only after useful interactions, and a proven identity collision or failed delivery burns the offending bonds and voids its attestations. A Sybil operator must therefore fund every fake account separately, then risk losing that capital when accounts coordinate fraud. Naming personas lotus, opal, and bridge does not reduce this cost: the attacker pays upfront and faces slashing before earning influence.
